summary: End-to-end verification of Phase-1 Shippo shipping-label integration for the maker dashboard. All 12 backend pytest cases green (live Shippo test-mode API). Frontend modal 3-step wizard works end-to-end — label actually purchased via UI (tracking 9334620845500000070833, USPS Ground Advantage $6.50). One UX regression found: the step-3 'done' screen unmounts almost instantly because onSuccess() triggers a parent refetch that collapses the order card and kills the modal before the user can copy the tracking # or open the PDF.

ui_bugs.issue: Step-3 'Label purchased' / 'Open Label PDF' / tracking-copy screen is shown for ~0ms because OrdersList.onSuccess does `setDetail(null) + onChange()` which unmounts the expanded order row — and with it the modal — before the user can interact. The purchase itself succeeds (ledger row + tx fulfilled + label URL returned), so this is a discoverability/UX bug, not a data bug. Reorder: don't call onSuccess() until the user clicks 'Done →', OR move the label-purchased confirmation into a non-modal persistent pill on the fulfilled order card.

React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, late-undefined … Check the render method of DashboardTab.' Duplicate-key warning fires on every maker dashboard render. Unrelated to Shippo, but surfaced during this iteration.
URL query `?tab=orders` is ignored — page always opens on the Dashboard tab. Sidebar must be clicked manually. Minor — deep-linking to /maker/dashboard?tab=orders from emails/docs won't work.

action_items: Fix ShippingLabelModal / OrdersList so step-3 'done' screen stays visible after a successful label purchase. Safest: defer `onSuccess()` until user clicks the Done → button. Optional: keep the modal mounted in OrdersList even if the order row collapses.
Investigate duplicate React key warning 'late-undefined' in DashboardTab render — unrelated but noisy.
(Optional) honour `?tab=orders` query param on /maker/dashboard for deep-linking.
critical_code_review_comments: shippo_service._client() rebuilds the SDK client on every call — fine for today's volume, consider module-level caching if /rates becomes hot.

_assert_owns_order loads every product for the maker on every shipping API call. For a maker with hundreds of products this is a full scan 3× per label flow. Consider indexing or filtering by the tx's items first.
SHIPPING_MARKUP_PCT is hard-coded 0.0 — fine for Phase 1 but add a TODO / env flag for Phase 2 so ops can toggle without code deploy.

buy_label() maps `LabelFileTypeEnum` with getattr + fallback PDF_4X6 — good defensive default, but client can silently get a different file type than requested. Consider logging when the fallback kicks in.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (full happy-path works, step-3 confirmation UI invisible)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 backend endpoints are wired correctly and Shippo test-mode integration is live (USPS returned 3 rates — Ground Advantage $6.50, Priority $8.30, Priority Express; UPS/FedEx not in Shippo test account). Cross-maker 404 isolation works. Ledger + payment_transactions mirror-write is correct. The ONE UX bug is in OrdersList+ShippingLabelModal — step-3 confirmation is invisible. Verify by fixing the onSuccess race and re-running the Playwright flow in this test file (seed one more pending order first: db.payment_transactions.update({session_id}, order_status='pending')).
rca of the issue: In ShippingLabelModal.onBuy the sequence is setPurchased(res) → setStep('done') → await onSuccess(). In OrdersList, onSuccess = () => { setDetail(null); await onChange(); }. onChange() refetches the orders list from the server; because the tx just flipped to order_status=fulfilled, it leaves the Pending filter (default view) and the expanded row is unmounted on next render — taking the ShippingLabelModal child with it. Net result: the user sees 'Purchasing…' spinner, a 200ms toast, and then modal + row vanish. Mitigation: hoist the modal to the parent OrdersTab so it's not a child of the order row, OR skip the refetch until the user clicks Done.
